meta.sourceNote: Real data: roads, paths, buildings, water, parks and street furniture from OpenStreetMap via Overture Maps; places from Overture (categories only); terrain from USGS 3DEP via AWS Terrain Tiles. Props flagged with a 4th element 1 are synthesized.
meta.frame: equirectangular around origin; x east, z south, y up; metres rounded to 0.1
meta.winding: outer rings counter-clockwise on a north-up map (negative shoelace area in raw x,z), holes the other way; rings do not repeat the first point

units.heights: m above the Potomac surface (river level 0)

meta.notes: ids: g/b/p + the first 12 hex digits of the Overture GERS id (stable across releases), .n when one feature became several pieces (split by bridge/tunnel/level/subclass rules or the crop). Road and path vertices at Overture connectors are kept and identical in every way that meets there, so graphs can be built by matching coordinates. Roads: lanes are estimates by class; width is the data width, else measured from the sidewalk lines either side (est: 2), else a class estimate (est: 1); sidewalk=separate where mapped sidewalks run alongside. Washington Circle is one closed road with junction=roundabout. Buildings: h from Overture height (OSM or USGS lidar), building parts or floors, else the median of neighbours of the same kind or a class default (est: 1). POIs: category only (OSM key=value from the Overture taxonomy), b = building id. Props: [x, z, kind] real, [x, z, kind, 1] synthesized. landmarks.canal.levels: canal water levels west to east between the locks (lock_gate props mark both ends of each chamber); waterways creek.levels: Rock Creek water level per vertex. heights: grid of terrain heights relative to the river, data[iz * nx + ix] at (x0 + ix * spacing, z0 + iz * spacing).
meta.attribution: Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Overture Maps Foundation (release 2026-10-21.0); places © Overture Maps Foundation (CDLA-Permissive-2.0); building heights include USGS 3DEP lidar, Microsoft ML Buildings and Esri Community Maps contributions; terrain: AWS Terrain Tiles (USGS 3DEP).
meta.licence: src/data/georgetown.json is a derivative database of OpenStreetMap data and is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0, https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). Overture places: CDLA-Permissive-2.0. Terrain: USGS 3DEP (public domain) via AWS Terrain Tiles. Street furniture flagged synth and all business names in the game are invented, not data.
